INSERT INTO gateway_log (request_id, timestamp, app_id, asset_id, asset_type, status, success, error_code, duration_ms, client_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cache_hit_tokens, cache_miss_tokens, tokens_per_second, time_to_first_token_ms, time_per_output_token_ms) VALUES
(#{item.requestId}, #{item.timestamp}, #{item.appId}, #{item.assetId}, #{item.assetType}, #{item.status}, #{item.success}, #{item.errorCode}, #{item.durationMs}, #{item.clientId}, #{item.usageDto.promptTokens}, #{item.usageDto.completionTokens}, #{item.usageDto.totalTokens}, #{item.usageDto.cacheHitTokens}, #{item.usageDto.cacheMissTokens}, #{item.usageDto.tokensPerSecond}, #{item.usageDto.timeToFirstTokenMs}, #{item.usageDto.timePerOutputTokenMs})

INSERT INTO gateway_log (request_id, timestamp, app_id, asset_id, asset_type, status, success, error_code, duration_ms, client_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cache_hit_tokens, cache_miss_tokens, tokens_per_second, time_to_first_token_ms, time_per_output_token_ms) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{timestamp}, #{appId}, #{assetId}, #{assetType}, #{status}, #{success}, #{errorCode}, #{durationMs}, #{clientId}, #{usageDto.promptTokens}, #{usageDto.completionTokens}, #{usageDto.totalTokens}, #{usageDto.cacheHitTokens}, #{usageDto.cacheMissTokens}, #{usageDto.tokensPerSecond}, #{usageDto.timeToFirstTokenMs}, #{usageDto.timePerOutputTokenMs})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_calls, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS success_rate FROM gateway_log WHERE `date` BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT client_id, COUNT(*) AS total_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_calls, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS success_rate FROM gateway_log WHERE `date` BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND client_id IS NOT NULL AND client_id != '' GROUP BY client_id ORDER BY total_calls DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS hour_bucket, COUNT(*) AS total_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_calls, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS success_rate FROM gateway_log WHERE `date` BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(timestamp, '%Y%m%d%H') ORDER BY hour_bucket

SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_tokens) / 1000000, 1) AS total_tokens_m, ROUND(SUM(prompt_tokens) / 1000000, 1) AS prompt_tokens_m, ROUND(SUM(completion_tokens) / 1000000, 1) AS completion_tokens_m, ROUND(SUM(cache_hit_tokens) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(cache_hit_tokens + cache_miss_tokens), 0), 1) AS cache_hit_rate, SUM(cache_hit_tokens) AS cache_hit_tokens, SUM(cache_miss_tokens) AS cache_miss_tokens FROM gateway_log WHERE `date` BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND success = 1

SELECT app_id, ROUND(SUM(total_tokens) / 1000000, 2) AS total_tokens_m, ROUND(SUM(prompt_tokens) / 1000000, 2) AS prompt_tokens_m, ROUND(SUM(completion_tokens) / 1000000, 2) AS completion_tokens_m, ROUND(SUM(cache_hit_tokens) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(cache_hit_tokens + cache_miss_tokens), 0), 1) AS cache_hit_rate, COUNT(*) AS call_count FROM gateway_log WHERE `date` BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND success = 1 GROUP BY app_id ORDER BY total_tokens_m DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT `date`, ROUND(SUM(total_tokens) / 1000000, 2) AS total_tokens_m, ROUND(SUM(prompt_tokens) / 1000000, 2) AS prompt_tokens_m, ROUND(SUM(completion_tokens) / 1000000, 2) AS completion_tokens_m, ROUND(SUM(cache_hit_tokens) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(cache_hit_tokens + cache_miss_tokens), 0), 1) AS cache_hit_rate FROM gateway_log WHERE `date` BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND success = 1 GROUP BY `date` ORDER BY `date`

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS apikey_pass_rate, COUNT(*) AS total_requests, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_requests, SUM(CASE WHEN error_code IN ('missing_api_key', 'invalid_api_key') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS apikey_auth_fail_count, SUM(CASE WHEN error_code IN ('addr_forbidden', 'unsafe_output_blocked', 'asset_not_found', 'asset_unavailable', 'missing_secret_config', 'invalid_runtime_endpoint') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS violation_call_count, SUM(CASE WHEN error_code = 'rate_limit_exceeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rate_limit_count, SUM(CASE WHEN error_code IN ('too_many_concurrent_requests', 'upstream_timeout', 'upstream_error', 'mcp_reroute_loop') OR (error_code = 'upstream_error' AND duration_ms > 30000) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS circuit_break_count, SUM(CASE WHEN error_code IN ('rate_limit_exceeded', 'too_many_concurrent_requests', 'upstream_timeout', 'upstream_error', 'mcp_reroute_loop') OR (error_code = 'upstream_error' AND duration_ms > 30000) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rate_limit_circuit_count FROM gateway_log WHERE `date` BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS hour_bucket, SUM(CASE WHEN error_code IN ('addr_forbidden', 'unsafe_output_blocked', 'asset_not_found', 'asset_unavailable', 'missing_secret_config', 'invalid_runtime_endpoint') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS violation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN error_code IN ('rate_limit_exceeded', 'too_many_concurrent_requests', 'upstream_timeout', 'upstream_error', 'mcp_reroute_loop') OR (error_code = 'upstream_error' AND duration_ms > 30000) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS circuit_limit_count, SUM(CASE WHEN error_code IN ('missing_api_key', 'invalid_api_key') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS apikey_fail_count FROM gateway_log WHERE `date` BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(timestamp, '%Y%m%d%H') ORDER BY hour_bucket

SELECT app_id, error_code AS violation_type, timestamp AS call_time, client_id AS call_ip, CONCAT('错误码:', error_code, ', HTTP:', status, ', 耗时:', duration_ms, 'ms') AS detail, request_id FROM gateway_log WHERE `date` BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND success = 0 AND error_code IN ('addr_forbidden', 'unsafe_output_blocked', 'asset_not_found', 'asset_unavailable', 'missing_secret_config', 'invalid_runtime_endpoint') ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gateway_log WHERE `date` BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND success = 0 AND error_code IN ('addr_forbidden', 'unsafe_output_blocked', 'asset_not_found', 'asset_unavailable', 'missing_secret_config', 'invalid_runtime_endpoint')

SELECT app_id, CASE WHEN error_code = 'rate_limit_exceeded' THEN '限流' WHEN error_code = 'too_many_concurrent_requests' THEN '熔断(并发超限)' WHEN error_code = 'upstream_timeout' THEN '熔断(上游超时)' WHEN error_code = 'upstream_error' AND duration_ms > 30000 THEN '熔断(上游错误+超时)' WHEN error_code = 'upstream_error' THEN '上游错误' WHEN error_code = 'mcp_reroute_loop' THEN '熔断(MCP路由循环)' ELSE '限流/熔断' END AS type, timestamp AS call_time, client_id AS call_ip, CONCAT(ROUND(duration_ms / 1000, 1), '秒') AS remark, error_code, request_id FROM gateway_log WHERE `date` BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND success = 0 AND ( error_code IN ('rate_limit_exceeded', 'too_many_concurrent_requests', 'upstream_timeout', 'upstream_error', 'mcp_reroute_loop') OR (error_code = 'upstream_error' AND duration_ms > 30000) ) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gateway_log WHERE `date` BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND success = 0 AND ( error_code IN ('rate_limit_exceeded', 'too_many_concurrent_requests', 'upstream_timeout', 'upstream_error', 'mcp_reroute_loop') OR (error_code = 'upstream_error' AND duration_ms > 30000) )

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') AS minute_bucket, COUNT(*) AS calls_per_minute, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 0) AS avg_duration_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count FROM gateway_log WHERE timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(timestamp, '%Y%m%d%H%i') ORDER BY minute_bucket

SELECT app_id, COUNT(*) AS total_calls, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS success_rate, ROUND(SUM(total_tokens) / 1000000, 2) AS total_tokens_m FROM gateway_log WHERE `date` >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY app_id ORDER BY total_calls DESC LIMIT #{limit}
